exactTopic.title: [WIP] Mythical Void — a father-and-son creature adventure made with Phaser
exactTopic.body:
Hi, I’m Kevin. My son and I started Mythical Void at home to see what imagination and today’s AI tools could help us make together. It has grown into a free browser game built with Phaser 3.

Play it here:
https://mythicalvoid.com/play/

You crash beyond mapped space, hatch an alien creature, explore six strange worlds and free Guardians trapped by the Void. What you do helps decide what Project Beacon tells Earth. It starts straight away, with no download or account.

If you try it, I would love two honest answers:
1. Was the first minute clear without an explanation?
2. Did movement and the controls make sense on the device you used?

This link opens the real running game. Generative AI is one of the tools we use to explore and build, but people make the story, safety and release decisions. Some optional space-discovery moments use credited public NASA material; NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

I am not attaching our current screenshots or videos because I do not think they show the game well enough yet. I will read and answer replies myself. Thank you for trying it.

generative AI is one tool in a human-led creative process
NASA does not endorse Mythical Void

latestReleaseDraft.title: The press room now has its own front door
latestReleaseDraft.selectionReason: Newest checked release that can travel as text without depending on gameplay media.

professionalNetworkDraft.body:
The press room now has its own front door

A dedicated public page now gives writers, creators and curious players a clear route to the real game, approved facts and the small set of assets that are safe to use.

• The page explains the playable browser adventure, the father-and-son beginning, the creature engine, the six realms, the careful use of AI and the optional NASA-based learning layer.
• It leads directly to the live game and offers only the approved emblem, fact sheet and STEM activity. The earlier gameplay media pack remains withheld because it did not pass human visual review.
• The press address now has its own title and canonical identity before JavaScript runs. This helps people and search tools understand the page, but it does not prove indexing, coverage, visits or play.

See what changed: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

Text-only release note about a live owned-site page; no screenshot or generated image is attached.

releaseProof.claimBoundary: The source, production deploy and live raw HTML prove that the press page exists with its own identity. They do not prove visual quality, play, enjoyment or growth; they also do not prove indexing, attention or playership.
